SPECIFICATION FOR STOCK AND SINGLE FLUKE STOCK ANCHORS (FOR HARBOUR USE)
0. FOREWORD

0.1This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution
on 27 December 1966, after the draft finalized by the Marine Engineering and Shipbuilding Sectional Committee had been approved by the Mechanical Engineering Division Council.

0.2 An anchor is designated by its nominal weight, The dimensions of the anchor and,its component parts depend upon the nominal weight and the design features of the anchor. The dimensions of the stock and single fluke stock anchors are same except that nominal weight of the single fluke type is 80 percent of the double fluke type. 0.3 This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards on anchors. Other standards in this series are: IS : 3267 - 1966 General requirements for anchors IS : 3268 - 1965 Specification for stockless anchors ( for ships' use ) IS : 3269-l 966 Specification for stock anchors ( for ships' use ) 0.4 In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following: JIS F 3361-1957 Anchors. Japanese Industrial Standards Committee PNW 83051- 1961 Admiralty anchor. Polish Standards Committee Rules and regulations for the construction and classification of steel ships. Lloyd's Register of Shipping, 1966
